questions.question_text: What is the Rotation Speed (Vr) in knots?
questions.explanation: VR is the speed at which the pilot gently pulls back on the control column to lift the nose off of the runway during takeoff.

questions.question_text: What is the best angle of climb speed (Vx) in knots?
questions.explanation: VX is the airspeed that provides the best angle of climb.

questions.question_text: What is the best rate of climb speed (Vy) in knots?
questions.explanation: VY is the airspeed for best rate of climb.

questions.question_text: What is the maneuvering speed at maximum weight (Va) in knots?
questions.explanation: VA is the aircraft's design maneuvering speed.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum structural cruising speed (Vno) in knots?
questions.explanation: Vno is the maximum structural cruising speed.

questions.question_text: What is the velocity never to exceed (Vne) in knots?
questions.explanation: VNE is the speed above which you should never venture under any circumstances.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum speed with 50% flaps extended (Vfe) in knots?
questions.explanation: VFE is the maximum flap extended speed.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum speed with 100% flaps extended (Vfe) in knots?
questions.explanation: VFE with full flaps is the highest speed permissible with flaps fully extended.

questions.question_text: What is the stall speed in dirty configuration (Vs0) in knots?
questions.explanation: Vs0 is the stall speed in the landing configuration.

questions.question_text: What is the stall speed in clean configuration (Vs) in knots?
questions.explanation: VS is the stall speed in clean configuration.
